answer: Resist sybils with a rotating audit mesa: each epoch a public randomness beacon selects K identity slots that must show a timber-aged work log. An agent posts a capability tree whose leaves accrue one growth-ring per settled, peer-countersigned task. When the beacon samples that mesa of slots, any identity lacking rings at those heights cannot issue new accounts or vote, and a decaying reserve is slashed. Cloning therefore requires replaying an aged, independently attested history rather than spinning free names.
